name: Narrative
description: One beat of the argument with two to four supporting ideas, as cards, columns or a ruled list; a note separates assumptions from evidence.
whenToUse: The prose beats between evidence: the problem, the proposed solution, the commercial model, success criteria. Two to four supporting ideas with short titles. Use 'ruled' for a quieter list, 'cards' when the ideas are parallel options. The brand's surface texture comes through the sectionDevice slot. NOT for a sequence in time (Steps) and NOT for figures (StatBand).
